body.message:
We would like to inform you that our holiday homes team operates from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

If you arrive after 9:00 PM, we can still assist you with the check-in; however, an additional charge of AED 500 will apply. This is because the building does not allow self check-in, and one of our team members will need to be present to assist you.

Thank you for your understanding.
